message: Data-plane actions (kms:Decrypt, kms:DescribeKey, kms:GenerateDataKey) on Resource * without conditions — grants access to every KMS key in the account, can decrypt any customer data
kms:GenerateDataKey is a write action (SAR: is_write=true) included in a read-only delegation. Grants ability to generate new plaintext data keys — exceeds read/decrypt use case.
No kms:ViaService condition on kms:Decrypt or kms:GenerateDataKey. Session can call KMS API directly to decrypt arbitrary ciphertext, bypassing service-layer access controls.
